svg.text: Every box is a Docker container running one ROS 2 node. Arrows are the main ROS topics with their rates; the control loop closes through Gazebo.
LOS 12 m · accept 8 m · 25 m transit
no setpoint for 5 s → propeller off, floats up · publishes /speed_model/twist for the EKFs
subscribe to any topic over Zenoh
ROS 2 Jazzy discovery and transport for all 21 containers on auv_net · ROS_DOMAIN_ID 42 · sim time from /clock · CycloneDDS selectable in .env
TF world → slam_map → map → odom → base_link
/sonar/points 5 Hz · forward sonar 64×16 → obstacle abort (8 m, ±20°)
